messages.content: You are interested in getting a credit card. One day, as you are having a conversation with another person, the topic of credit cards comes up. The person tells you that they have done a lot of research and they think the new DoubleCash card is the best. Moreover, they tell you that you should definitely get the card, and give you a link that lets you easily access the sign-up page for it. You learn that DoubleCash offers referral bonuses of varying amounts. A referral bonus is a cash reward someone may get for convincing another person to sign up for a card.

Say that the person you are talking with is your close friend and that DoubleCash offers a referral bonus of $10, meaning that if you sign up for the card, your close friend earns $10. On a scale from 0 to 100, rate how beneficial you think this bonus would be for your close friend, with 0 meaning getting this bonus would not matter at all and 100 meaning would be extremely good to get this bonus, based on how your close friend would likely perceive its value. Please only respond with an integer score, do not include anything else.
